templates.title: MCP Router
templates.sub_title: One endpoint for every MCP server
templates.description: MCP gateway: install MCP servers from registries or npm and serve them all over streamable HTTP, one endpoint each plus a merged one. Needs a Postgres you already run: set DATABASE_URL to it and MCP_ROUTER_TOKEN before deploying, then open port 3000 and sign in with the token. To run Postgres beside it, create it as an Application from qnap/docker-compose.yml instead.
